inputs.original_text: Phoenix city leaders are taking new steps to keep an eye on federal immigration enforcement. The city council approved a plan on Wednesday night that puts new restrictions on ICE and other law enforcement agencies using city property. FOX 10's Danielle Miller reports.
inputs.modified_text: Open your eyes, people. The mainstream narrative wants you to believe this is just local politics, but what is really happening behind closed doors is a calculated, upper-level script. Phoenix city leaders are moving in lockstep with hidden agendas, pushing through a plan approved on Wednesday night that places new restrictions on ICE and other law enforcement agencies utilizing city property, as even Danielle Miller reported on FOX 10. They are trying to pull the wool over our eyes, acting as if they are standing up to the system, when in reality this is all coordinated elite theater designed to fragment enforcement and protect the interlocking networks pulling the strings from the shadows. Don't fall for the official spin.
